history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration select custodians on a more transparent and competitive basis and maintain complete documentation of the decision-making process.
history.administration_response: The Administration considers this recommendation to be implemented and requests its closure. The Office of Programme Planning, Finance and Budget, in collaboration with the Procurement Division, is conducting a competitive solicitation exercise for custody services. This process is intended to identify and select the most qualified service providers through a transparent and rigorous evaluation. The request for expressions of interest was issued in July 2024, inviting potential custodian banks to submit their proposals and demonstrate their capabilities. Once this process is finalized, a new custodian bank will be appointed. The Office therefore recommends the closure of this recommendation.
history.board_assessment: Given that United Nations has already posted the request for expressions of interest, entitled “Provision of global custody service for the United Nations Treasury”, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
